notes: bot v8: local-first backend routing for the backend-on-phone programme. The bot now prefers the phone-local backend at http://127.0.0.1:8787 (env PAN_BACKEND_LOCAL override) and falls back to the cloud backend (env PAN_BACKEND, default https://pan-search-5160265-1520428323.ap-shanghai.run.tcloudbase.com) only when the local one is unreachable at network level. Per-flow pinning: each search flow (and each new candidate within it) probes GET {local}/api/health with a 2s timeout; healthy -> the whole flow (search, submit, poll) uses local; probe failure -> the flow runs on cloud and a 60s breaker skips re-probing. Session affinity (design 5.2): submit/poll calls carrying a local-issued ref are NEVER flipped to cloud mid-flow (the ref would 400 there); a network error there fails the candidate and the existing candidate fallthrough re-probes and re-searches on the new base. Search calls may flip in place. HTTP business errors never trigger flipping, and a merely slow search does not flip (existing timeouts govern). One log line per local-to-cloud flip and one on local recovery; the startup line now reports 'backend: local-first ..., cloud fallback ...'. Also new in v8: owner-only group commands for log return - sending the log command returns the last 40 lines of bot.log in-group, and the backend-log command returns backend.log (at most 1500 chars per message, at most 2 messages, newest kept with a truncation note; lines containing the word cookie are skipped whole; a missing backend.log gets an explicit not-exist reply). Everything else identical to v7: identity-verified single-instance lock (JSON {pid, start}, holder honored only when /proc cmdline and starttime verify), ranked candidate fallthrough (up to 3 candidates tried silently), empty-search retry, 21:00-23:59 Asia/Shanghai digest poster, message_id dedup, video-over-novel pick. Scripts v8: unchanged from the previous release - start_qqbot.sh aligns the in-container NapCat launcher quick-login account to 411649762 before NapCat starts (one-time .bak, atomic rewrite, never blocks stack start); OneBot per-account config seeding/self-healing unchanged.
